div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://mitre.org/fhir/space-health/CodeSystem/space-motion-sickness-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Motion sickness occurring during initial adaptation to microgravity, typically within the first 72 hours of spaceflight
Motion sickness occurring upon return to Earth gravity after spaceflight
Persistent sensation of rocking or swaying after spaceflight or prolonged motion exposure
Sensory conflict between vestibular, visual, and proprioceptive inputs in altered gravity
